technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with extreme overbought signals and new highs, but weak trend confirmation (low ADX) and elevated reversal risk limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 54 days create a low-conviction setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; broad market fear (39 Fear/Greed, 45.8% bearish) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional activity (154+ days) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (413.28), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent CPI event create severe macro headwinds; earnings in 54 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (RSI extreme overbought, AO cross-up, new 20-day highs, rising OBV) with broad market fear creating potential contrarian swing opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis 413.28, flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent CPI), weak trend confirmation (ADX 19.85), overbought reversal risk, zero fundamental conviction, and price below 200-EMA/50-SMA create a high-probability fade setup.
